method: Read-only threshold bounding boxes in manually isolated text regions of original-resolution source. White text min(R,G,B)>180/210/230; gold R>threshold,G>110,B<170. Bounds divided by3.75. Approximate ink extent, excluding shadows; not pristine glyph extraction.
thresholdSensitivity: Listed label bounds usually differ less than0.3 normalized pixels across thresholds. Region selection/CRT/fringing can introduce additional1–2 pixel uncertainty. Run crop may include adjacent fringe.
